_comment: Advisories (a package name or an advisory url) that may stay high or critical, each with a reason and an until date (YYYY-MM-DD). An expired entry fails the audit.

allow.reason: picomatch <= 4.0.7 ReDoS through repeated extglobs (published 19 Oct, flagged 17 Nov 2026); no patched version exists. It is reached only through the app's build tools (react-native > metro > jest-util / micromatch, and tinyglobby > fdir), which match the repository's own file patterns at build time; no server or app code passes outside input to it. Review when picomatch ships a fix.
